# rename

Muster-owned session title override, inline rename in the mainhead and tiles.

Read first: `docs/features/rename/spec.md`, `docs/features/rename/contract.md`

- `kb:adr/rename-claude-change-after-delivery-clears-override` — Once a rename has reached Claude Code, a later different name from Claude Code clears the title override; the last rename wins wherever it was made. (accepted, 2026-10-15; features: rename, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/rename-claude-change-after-delivery-clears-override.md`
- `kb:adr/rename-muster-owned-title-override-wins` — A post-launch rename is a Muster-owned nullable title override that wins over the status-line name; the wire title is the display title. (accepted, 2026-09-03; features: rename, tiles, focus) → `docs/adr/rename-muster-owned-title-override-wins.md`
- `kb:adr/rename-pushed-to-claude-once` — A rename is sent to Claude Code once, via the next UserPromptSubmit reply's sessionTitle or --name on resume; no duplicate-name warning or registry read-back. (accepted, 2026-10-15; features: rename, ingest, launch) → `docs/adr/rename-pushed-to-claude-once.md`
- `kb:adr/views-active-segment-click-commits-rename` — Clicking the already-pressed view segment commits an open rename instead of cancelling it and sends no prefs request; switching views still cancels. (accepted, 2026-09-03; features: views, rename) → `docs/adr/views-active-segment-click-commits-rename.md`
- `kb:fact/command-hook-session-title-holds` — A command UserPromptSubmit hook printing sessionTitle renames the session as the http reply does, and the name then holds; no auto-generated title replaces it. (active, 2026-10-15; verified 2.1.300..2.1.300; features: rename, ingest) → `docs/facts/command-hook-session-title-holds.md`
- `kb:fact/hook-output-sets-session-title` — A UserPromptSubmit hook's hookSpecificOutput.sessionTitle renames the session (nameSource "hook"); SessionStart's output accepts the same field. (active, 2026-10-05; verified 2.1.289..2.1.289; features: rename, ingest) → `docs/facts/hook-output-sets-session-title.md`
- `kb:fact/name-flag-reaches-title` — claude --name X yields SessionStart.session_title == X and status-line session_name == X; the title survives --resume. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.267..2.1.301; features: launch, rename) → `docs/facts/name-flag-reaches-title.md`
- `kb:fact/session-name-survives-clear-compact-resume` — A name survives /clear (onto the new session id), /compact and --resume, each SessionStart carrying it as session_title; --resume <id> --name X renames. (active, 2026-10-05; verified 2.1.289..2.1.289; features: rename, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/session-name-survives-clear-compact-resume.md`
- `kb:fact/session-name-uniqueness-flagged` — Duplicate session names are refused only while server flag tengu_session_name_uniqueness is on; it was off on 2026-10-05, and duplicates were allowed. (active, 2026-10-05; verified 2.1.289..2.1.289; features: rename, launch) → `docs/facts/session-name-uniqueness-flagged.md`
- `kb:fact/session-registry-names-running-sessions` — ~/.claude/sessions/<pid>.json now names its running session — sessionId, name, nameSource, nameSince, status — and claude agents --json lists the same. (active, 2026-10-05; verified 2.1.289..2.1.289; features: rename, launch) → `docs/facts/session-registry-names-running-sessions.md`
- `kb:fact/slash-rename-immediate-no-hook` — /rename <name> applies at once, even mid-turn, and fires no hook; the registry and transcript change immediately, the status line only on its next post. (active, 2026-10-05; verified 2.1.289..2.1.289; features: rename) → `docs/facts/slash-rename-immediate-no-hook.md`
- `kb:fact/status-session-name-source` — Status-line session_name carries --name when given, otherwise a title Claude Code auto-generates; it is absent until one exists. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: rename, usage) → `docs/facts/status-session-name-source.md`
